014package org.microbean.scopelet;
015
016import java.lang.invoke.MethodHandles;
017import java.lang.invoke.MethodHandles.Lookup;
018import java.lang.invoke.VarHandle;
019
020import java.util.List;
021import java.util.Map;
022import java.util.Objects;
023
024import org.microbean.attributes.Attributes;
025import org.microbean.attributes.BooleanValue;
026import org.microbean.attributes.Value;
027
028import org.microbean.bean.Bean;
029import org.microbean.bean.Id;
030import org.microbean.bean.Factory;
031import org.microbean.bean.Request;
032
033import org.microbean.attributes.Attributes;
034
035import static org.microbean.assign.Qualifiers.primordialQualifier;
036import static org.microbean.assign.Qualifiers.qualifier;

038/**
039 * A manager of object lifespans identified by a scope.
040 *
041 * @param <S> the {@link Scopelet} subtype extending this class
042 *
043 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
044 */
045public abstract class Scopelet<S extends Scopelet<S>> implements AutoCloseable, Factory<S> {
046
047
048  /*
049   * Static fields.
050   */
051
052
053  private static final VarHandle CLOSED;
054
055  private static final VarHandle ME;
056
057  static {
058    final Lookup lookup = MethodHandles.lookup();
059    try {
060      CLOSED = lookup.findVarHandle(Scopelet.class, "closed", boolean.class);
061      ME = lookup.findVarHandle(Scopelet.class, "me", Scopelet.class);
062    } catch (final NoSuchFieldException | IllegalAccessException e) {
063      throw new ExceptionInInitializerError(e);
064    }
065  }
066
067
068  //
069  // Experimental; relocating/dismissing microbean-scope
070  //
071
072
073  /**
074   * An {@link Attributes} identifying the <dfn>scope designator</dfn>.
075   */
076  public static final Attributes SCOPE = Attributes.of("Scope");
077
078  private static final Map<String, Value<?>> normalScope = Map.of("normal", BooleanValue.of(true));
079
080  private static final Map<String, Value<?>> pseudoScope = Map.of("normal", BooleanValue.of(false));
081
082
083  /**
084   * An {@link Attributes} identifying the (well-known) <dfn>singleton pseudo-scope</dfn>.
085   *
086   * <p>The {@link Attributes} constituting the singleton pseudo-scope identifier is {@linkplain Attributes#attributes()
087   * attributed} with {@linkplain #SCOPE the scope designator}, {@linkplain org.microbean.assign.Qualifiers#qualifier()
088   * the qualifier designator}, and {@linkplain org.microbean.assign.Qualifiers#primordialQualifier() the primordial
089   * qualifier}, indicating that the scope it identifies governs itself.</p>
090   */
091  public static final Attributes SINGLETON_ID =
092    Attributes.of("Singleton", pseudoScope, Map.of(), Map.of("Singleton", List.of(qualifier(), SCOPE, primordialQualifier())));
093
094  /**
095   * An {@link Attributes} identifying the (well-known and <dfn>normal</dfn>) <dfn>application scope</dfn>.
096   */
097  public static final Attributes APPLICATION_ID =
098    Attributes.of("Application", normalScope, Map.of(), Map.of("Application", List.of(qualifier(), SCOPE, SINGLETON_ID)));
099
100  /**
101   * An {@link Attributes} identifying the (well-known) <dfn>none pseudo-scope</dfn>.
102   */
103  public static final Attributes NONE_ID =
104    Attributes.of("None", pseudoScope, Map.of(), Map.of("None", List.of(qualifier(), SCOPE, SINGLETON_ID)));
105
106
107  //
108  // End experimental
109  //
110
111
112  /*
113   * Instance fields.
114   */
115
116
117  private volatile S me;
118
119  private volatile boolean closed;
120
121  private final Attributes scopeId;
122
123
124  /*
125   * Constructors.
126   */
127
128
129  /**
130   * Creates a new {@link Scopelet}.
131   *
132   * @param scopeId an {@link Attributes} identifying the scope being implemented; must not be {@code null}
133   *
134   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code scopeId} is {@code null}
135   */
136  protected Scopelet(final Attributes scopeId) {
137    super();
138    this.scopeId = Objects.requireNonNull(scopeId, "scopeId");
139  }
140
141
142  /*
143   * Instance methods.
144   */
145
146
147  /**
148   * Returns an {@link Id} representing this {@link Scopelet}.
149   *
150   * <p>Implementations of this method must return determinate values.</p>
151   *
152   * @return an {@link Id} representing this {@link Scopelet}; never {@code null}
153   *
154   * @see #bean()
155   */
156  public abstract Id id();
157
158  /**
159   * A convenience method that eturns a {@link Bean} for this {@link Scopelet}.
160   *
161   * <p>This {@link Scopelet} will be used as the {@link Bean}'s {@linkplain Bean#factory() associated
162   * <code>Factory</code>}. This {@link Scopelet}'s {@link #id() Id} will be used as the {@link Bean}'s {@linkplain
163   * Bean#id() identifier}.</p>
164   *
165   * @return a {@link Bean} for this {@link Scopelet}; never {@code null}
166   *
167   * @see #id()
168   */
169  public final Bean<S> bean() {
170    return new Bean<>(this.id(), this);
171  }
172
173  /**
174   * Creates this {@link Scopelet} by simply returning it.
175   *
176   * @return this {@link Scopelet}
177   */
178  @Override // Factory<S>
179  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
180  public final S create(final Request<S> r) {
181    if (ME.compareAndSet(this, null, this)) { // volatile write
182      if (r != null) {
183        // TODO: emit initialized event
184      }
185    }
186    return (S)this;
187  }
188
189  /**
190   * Returns this {@link Scopelet} if it has been created via the {@link #create(Request)} method, or {@code null} if
191   * that method has not yet been invoked.
192   *
193   * @return this {@link Scopelet} if it has been "{@linkplain #create(Request) created}"; {@code null} otherwise
194   *
195   * @see #create(Request)
196   */
197  @Override // Factory<S>
198  public final S singleton() {
199    return this.me; // volatile read
200  }
201
202  /**
203   * Returns {@code true} when invoked to indicate that {@link Scopelet} implementations {@linkplain
204   * Factory#destroy(Object, Request) destroy} what they {@linkplain #create(Request) create}.
205   *
206   * @return {@code true} when invoked
207   *
208   * @see Factory#destroy(Object, Request)
209   *
210   * @see #create(Request)
211   */
212  @Override // Factory<S>
213  public final boolean destroys() {
214    return true;
215  }
216
217  /**
218   * Returns a hashcode for this {@link Scopelet}.
219   *
220   * @return a hashcode for this {@link Scopelet}
221   */
222  @Override // Object
223  public int hashCode() {
224    int hashCode = 17;
225    hashCode = 31 * hashCode + this.id().hashCode();
226    hashCode = 31 * hashCode + this.scopeId().hashCode();
227    return hashCode;
228  }
229
230  /**
231   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Object} is not {@code null}, has the same class as this
232   * {@link Scopelet}, has an {@link #id() Id} {@linkplain Id#equals(Object) equal to} that of this {@link Scopelet},
233   * and a {@linkplain #scopeId() scope identifier} {@linkplain Attributes#equals(Object) equal to} that of this
234   * {@link Scopelet}.
235   *
236   * @param other the {@link Object} to test; may be {@code null}
237   *
238   * @return {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Object} is not {@code null}, has the same class as this
239   * {@link Scopelet}, has an {@link #id() Id} {@linkplain Id#equals(Object) equal to} that of this {@link Scopelet},
240   * and a {@linkplain #scopeId() scope identifier} {@linkplain Attributes#equals(Object) equal to} that of this
241   * {@link Scopelet}
242   */
243  @Override // Object
244  public boolean equals(final Object other) {
245    if (other == this) {
246      return true;
247    } else if (other != null && other.getClass().equals(this.getClass())) {
248      final Scopelet<?> her = (Scopelet<?>)other;
249      return
250        Objects.equals(this.id(), her.id()) &&
251        Objects.equals(this.scopeId(), her.scopeId());
252    } else {
253      return false;
254    }
255  }
256
257
258  /*
259   * Repository-like concerns.
260   */
261
262
263  /**
264   * Returns the {@link Attributes} that identifies this {@link Scopelet}'s affiliated scope.
265   *
266   * @return the {@link Attributes} that identifies this {@link Scopelet}'s affiliated scope; never {@code null}
267   */
268  public final Attributes scopeId() {
269    return this.scopeId;
270  }
271
272  /**
273   * Returns {@code true} if and only if this {@link Scopelet} is <dfn>active</dfn> at the moment of the call.
274   *
275   * <p>Overrides of this method must ensure that if {@link #closed()} returns {@code true}, this method must return
276   * {@code false}.</p>
277   *
278   * @return {@code true} if and only if this {@link Scopelet} is <dfn>active</dfn> at the moment of the call
279   *
280   * @see #closed()
281   */
282  public boolean active() {
283    return !this.closed(); // volatile read
284  }
285
286  /**
287   * Checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active} and then returns {@code true} if and only
288   * if, at the moment of an invocation, this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active} and already contains an
289   * object identified by the supplied {@link Object}.
290   *
291   * <p>The default implementation of this method checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is
292   * active}, and then {@code true} if and only if the result of invoking the {@link #instance(Object, Factory,
293   * Request)} method with the supplied {@code id}, {@code null}, and {@code null} is not {@code null}.</p>
294   *
295   * <p>Subclasses are encouraged to override this method to be more efficient or to use a different algorithm.</p>
296   *
297   * @param id the {@link Object} serving as an identifier; may be {@code null} in certain pathological cases
298   *
299   * @return {@code true} if and only if, at the moment of an invocation, this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is
300   * active} and contains a preexisting object identified by the supplied {@link Object}
301   *
302   * @exception InactiveScopeletException if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is not active}
303   *
304   * @see #active()
305   *
306   * @see #instance(Object, Factory, Request)
307   */
308  public boolean containsId(final Object id) {
309    return (id instanceof Request<?> r ? this.instance(r) : this.instance(id, null, null)) != null;
310  }
311
312  /**
313   * Checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active}, and then returns the preexisting
314   * contextual instance identified by the supplied {@link Object}, or {@code null} if no such instance exists.
315   *
316   * <p>This convenience method checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active}, and then, if
317   * the supplied {@link Object} is not a {@link Request}, calls the {@link #instance(Object, Factory, Request)} method
318   * with the supplied {@code id}, {@code null}, and {@code null}, and returns its result.</p>
319   *
320   * <p>If the supplied {@link Object} <em>is</em> a {@link Request}, this method calls the {@link #instance(Request)}
321   * method with the supplied (cast) {@code id} and returns its result.</p>
322   *
323   * @param <I> the type of contextual instance
324   *
325   * @param id an {@link Object} serving as an identifier; may be {@code null} in certain pathological cases
326   *
327   * @return the contextual instance identified by the supplied {@link Object}, or {@code null} if no such instance
328   * exists
329   *
330   * @exception InactiveScopeletException if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is not active}
331   *
332   * @see #instance(Object, Factory, Request)
333   *
334   * @see #instance(Request)
335   */
336  // id is nullable.
337  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
338  public final <I> I get(final Object id) {
339    return id instanceof Request<?> r ? this.instance((Request<I>)r) : this.instance(id, null, null);
340  }
341
342  /**
343   * Checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active} and then eturns a contextual instance
344   * identified by the {@linkplain Request#beanReduction() identifying information} present within the supplied {@link
345   * Request}, creating the instance and associating it with the {@linkplain Request#beanReduction() identifying
346   * information} present within the supplied {@link Request} if necessary.
347   *
348   * @param <I> the type of contextual instance
349   *
350   * @param request a {@link Request}; may be {@code null} in which case the return value of an invocation of {@link
351   * #instance(Object, Factory, Request)} with {@code null} supplied for all three arguments will be returned instead
352   *
353   * @return an appropriate contextual instance, or {@code null}
354   *
355   * @exception InactiveScopeletException if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is not active}
356   *
357   * @see Request#beanReduction()
358   *
359   * @see #instance(Object, Factory, Request)
360   */
361  public final <I> I instance(final Request<I> request) {
362    if (request == null) {
363      return this.instance(null, null, null);
364    }
365    final Bean<I> bean = request.beanReduction().bean();
366    return this.instance(bean.id(), bean.factory(), request);
367  }
368
369  /**
370   * Checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active} and then returns a pre-existing or
371   * created-on-demand contextual instance suitable for the combination of identifier, {@link Factory} and {@link
372   * Request}.
373   *
374   * @param <I> the type of contextual instance
375   *
376   * @param id an identifier that can identify a contextual instance; may be {@code null}
377   *
378   * @param factory a {@link Factory}; may be {@code null}
379   *
380   * @param request a {@link Request}, typically the one in effect that is causing this method to be invoked in the
381   * first place; may be {@code null}
382   *
383   * @return a contextual instance, possibly pre-existing, or possibly created just in time, or {@code null}
384   *
385   * @exception InactiveScopeletException if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is not active}
386   */
387  // All parameters are nullable, perhaps pathologically. This helps permit super early bootstrapping.
388  public abstract <I> I instance(final Object id, final Factory<I> factory, final Request<I> request);
389
390  /**
391   * Checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active} and then removes any contextual instance
392   * stored under the supplied {@code id}, returning {@code true} if and only if removal actually took place.
393   *
394   * <p>The default implementation of this method always returns {@code false}. Subclasses are encouraged to override
395   * it as appropriate.</p>
396   *
397   * @param id an identifier; may be {@code null}
398   *
399   * @return {@code true} if and only if removal actually occurred
400   *
401   * @exception InactiveScopeletException if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is not active}
402   */
403  // id is nullable.
404  public boolean remove(final Object id) {
405    if (!this.active()) {
406      throw new InactiveScopeletException();
407    }
408    return false;
409  }
410
411  /**
412   * Irrevocably closes this {@link Scopelet}, and, by doing so, notionally makes it irrevocably {@linkplain #active()
413   * inactive}.
414   *
415   * @see #closed()
416   *
417   * @see #active()
418   */
419  // Most scopelets will want to override this to do additional work. They must call super.close() to ensure #closed()
420  // returns an appropriate value.
421  @Override // AutoCloseable
422  public void close() {
423    CLOSED.compareAndSet(this, false, true); // volatile write
424  }
425
426  /**
427   * Returns {@code true} if and only if at the moment of invocation this {@link Scopelet} is (irrevocably) closed (and
428   * therefore also {@linkplain #active() not active}).
429   *
430   * @return {@code true} if and only if at the moment of invocation this {@link Scopelet} is (irrevocably) closed (and
431   * therefore also {@linkplain #active() not active})
432   */
433  protected final boolean closed() {
434    return this.closed; // volatile read
435  }
436
437}
